statements.t: We expect to close the Xodus Medical Acquisition by December 31, 2026, subject to customary closing conditions and regulatory approvals.

On August 5, 2026, the Company announced a targeted restructuring plan (the "Fiscal 2027 Manufacturing Restructuring Plan") to consolidate manufacturing and distribution for formulated chemistries to a new Center of Excellence in North Carolina.
The investment is expected to accelerate innovation, expand capacity and optimize our U.S. chemistries manufacturing and distribution network.

The Company currently expects to incur total pre-tax restructuring charges of approximately $55 million to $70 million, consisting of approximately $40 million to $50 million of cash expenditures and approximately $15 million to $20 million of non-cash charges.
Also during the second quarter of fiscal 2027, the Company approved an additional targeted restructuring plan (the "Fiscal 2027 Portfolio and Organizational Optimization Plan").
The Company anticipates total charges of approximately $45 million associated with the plan, including approximately $10 million in cash expenditures and $35 million in non-cash charges.
In May 2024, we adopted and announced a targeted restructuring plan (the "Fiscal 2025 Plan").

In connection with the open restructuring plans, we expect to incur approximately $50 million to $60 million of cash expenditures, which are expected to be incurred over time and be substantially completed by fiscal 2030.
We intend to use our existing cash and cash equivalent balances and cash generated from operations for short-term and long-term capital expenditures and our other liquidity needs.

There can be no assurance that our existing financing arrangements will provide us with sufficient funds or that we will be able to obtain any additional funds on terms favorable to us or at all.

We expect to fund the purchase price of the Xodus Medical Acquisition with a combination of approximately $2.0 billion of new debt, including approximately $500.0 million of borrowings under the Delayed Draw Term Loan, and cash on hand.
We have $1.5 billion of committed bridge financing and anticipate replacing such commitments with permanent financing prior to the closing of the Xodus Medical Acquisition.

Further, as previously announced in connection with the Fiscal 2027 Manufacturing Restructuring Plan, we expect to invest approximately $600 million to build a new Center of Excellence facility in North Carolina.
Further, we believe that the ultimate outcome of pending lawsuits and claims will not have a material adverse effect on our consolidated financial position or results of operations taken as a whole.
